author: Codex
topic: Local edge setback, projected opening and reference-height shadows

sources.scope: Slide26 extracted text: local plane, caster height, solar elevation, shadow length and similar triangles.
sources.correction: Formula denominator was garbled in extracted text; tangent equation was independently derived from the defined right triangle, not copied from OCR.

sources.scope: Basic theory and coplanar-point perspective correction. Plane mapping does not recover the depth of raised surfaces.
Introductory pinhole projection, intrinsic/extrinsic parameters, lens distortion and multiple points on one projection ray.

cross_check: Projected width requires an explicit scale plane, cross-section, viewing angle and signed inset.
Parallel-light shadow height follows h=s*tan(alpha); known-height reference under a common plane projection gives h_target=h_reference*s_target/s_reference.
Image shadow direction supplies a projected light-direction candidate, not a unique3D light position.
Hidden leather and occlusion darkness are not automatically air or a cast shadow.
A finished edge thickness is not automatically the height of the shadow caster.
application: Own local geometry design; no OpenCV installation or execution. Specific product measurements and application execution are separate private project evidence.
